items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: one of them I want to work with him on is the Debussy “First Rhapsody”

ctx.x: There’s something about — and I’ve done a little bit, not much, but there are so many good classical clarinet players out there that do it really, really well. And I don’t know there’s something in classical music that I’m not getting or I just feel like there’s so many people that can do it so much better than I could. Just let them do their thing and I can play to my strengths. But I don’t know it’s funny you should mention that because I just hooked back up with my first clarinet teacher. And I had a lesson…
And we get so used to taking liberties with our music. We’re making it up a lot of times so it really takes a different kind of concentration I think, to stick to the page.
